source_notes: Re-verified construction status against three independent non-GEM publishers, each explicitly evidencing the terminal is not yet operating: (1) movimentoeconomico.com.br (Jan 2026) reports Regas de Suape 'entra em operacao em 2027' with 'obras' ongoing; (2) portosenavios.com.br: Suape 'tera terminal de regaseificacao' (future tense, R$2bn investment, not yet built); (3) megawhat.energy: Pernambuco and Oncorp signed the R$2bn contract for the 'novo terminal' (pre-operational milestone). All three corroborate GEM 'construction'; status unchanged. Verified via url_verifier.py on status-explicit tokens (operacao em 2027 / tera terminal / novo terminal).
